note: Motion-not-slides direction menus. Original English wording for Social Motion Agent, adapted from the ideas in bangtutorial/bang-motion (MIT). Menus are starting points chosen per brief, not quotas or bans; the user's brand and explicit choices always win.
style_brief_fields: Subject/product and three adjectives for the feeling it should leave
Concept: three candidates from the opener concept menu, one chosen with a product reason
Structure fingerprint: concept · scene count · main object per scene · opening · ending
Palette: main color FROM the brand, background, accent; every hex with its source or 'derived: reason'
Display font with character + companion font (product UI font when UI is shown)
Text emphasis: none, or exactly one highlight form
Background plan per segment: one direction, or which segment changes, to what, why and what triggers it
Motion signature: one repeated object/text motion that becomes the identity
Background motion: one language from the background-motion menu (separate from the signature)
Background surface: at least two layers from the surface menu
Object render family: one family, or a deliberate switch used as a moment
Assets: who supplies photos/video (user, authorized generation, licensed stock) and the shot list
Transitions: which boundaries need an effect and which are plain cuts
One special moment where the most expensive effect is used, once

style_directions.name: Cinematic dark
style_directions.background: near-black gradient, particles, bloom only on objects
style_directions.signature_motion: push-through, light in front of the lens

style_directions.name: Poster color-block
style_directions.background: large solid color fields changing per scene, fine grain
style_directions.typography: ultra-heavy display, giant letters cropped by the frame edge
style_directions.signature_motion: block wipes, text slamming into the frame edge

style_directions.name: Editorial light
style_directions.signature_motion: calm slides, lines that draw themselves, quiet camera

style_directions.name: Paper & print
style_directions.background: paper texture, collage cutouts, stamps, tape
style_directions.signature_motion: objects fly in and land at an angle

style_directions.name: Retro / analog
style_directions.background: faded color, grain, scanlines, tape frame
style_directions.signature_motion: controlled glitch, rough zoom, freeze frame

style_directions.name: Brutalist mono
style_directions.background: black and white, hard grid, ruled boxes
style_directions.signature_motion: hard cuts, shifting blocks, blinking cursor

style_directions.name: Luxury dark
style_directions.background: black with gold/bronze, soft shadows, sheen

style_directions.name: Flat pop with photos
style_directions.background: neutral light alternating with solid brand color fields; flat shapes derived from the logo
style_directions.typography: rounded heavy geometric sans + giant cropped words
style_directions.signature_motion: photo cutouts pop in from below, stickers burst elastically, color fields snap on the beat

style_directions.name: Grainy gradient
style_directions.background: deep base, saturated 2-3 color shapes glowing from inside, fine grain over the whole frame
style_directions.typography: small clean grotesk or minimal heavy display
style_directions.signature_motion: shape layers open and rotate slowly, the camera passes through openings, a guiding light orb

explainer_modes.name: Continuous action
explainer_modes.look: flowing vector world, one subject that never leaves, changing viewpoints and instruments (map, speedometer, profile)

explainer_modes.name: Cartoon collage
explainer_modes.look: cream paper, flat illustration cutouts, handwriting, color pills; camera glides over still assets

explainer_modes.name: Visual journalism
explainer_modes.look: black ground with grain, real photos with source tags, highlighter, dashed annotations

explainer_modes.name: White catalog
explainer_modes.look: faint white grid, product photo cutouts, mixed heavy sans + script, scribbles

explainer_modes.name: Vintage sketch
explainer_modes.look: sepia paper, engraving-style art multiplied onto the page, classic serifs, rust and gold notes

explainer_modes.name: Cartoon stage
explainer_modes.look: one living stage per scene (10+ moving things), jointed characters, camera zoom 1.08-1.95 inside the stage, short cut/slide between stages, no captions

opener_concepts.name: One continuous shot
opener_concepts.premise: the whole film is one space or object with no cut
opener_concepts.structure: one long scene with 4-6 moments; text sits on world surfaces
opener_concepts.camera: camera keeps travelling (dolly, orbit); a new moment is a new place the camera arrives at

opener_concepts.name: Pure typography
opener_concepts.premise: words are the subject; no mockups
opener_concepts.structure: a sentence builds, breaks and recombines; letters end as the logo
opener_concepts.camera: rhythm from the audio; words arrive from 5+ different directions

opener_concepts.name: Problem -> gone
opener_concepts.premise: a chaotic world is tidied by one product action
opener_concepts.structure: one chaos scene that peaks -> one product gesture -> clean world -> logo
opener_concepts.camera: chaos shakes and stacks; the product action is one large sweeping move

opener_concepts.name: Before / after
opener_concepts.premise: the difference is seen side by side
opener_concepts.structure: split screen or a moving divider; every slide of the divider is one feature

opener_concepts.name: Journey inside the UI
opener_concepts.premise: the camera flies inside a giant interface
opener_concepts.structure: buttons become platforms, the cursor guides; features are places passed

opener_concepts.name: Product macro
opener_concepts.premise: extreme close-ups, one detail at a time
opener_concepts.structure: 4-6 details, minimal text; the whole product appears only at the end
opener_concepts.camera: rack focus, slow turns, light sweeping across surfaces

opener_concepts.name: Object metaphor
opener_concepts.premise: the product as a real object that changes shape
opener_concepts.structure: one object (key, seed, bridge...) transforms through the film and ends as the logo

opener_concepts.name: Living number
opener_concepts.premise: one big number becomes the story
opener_concepts.structure: the number changes and every change reveals context (time saved, speed, users)
opener_concepts.camera: the number stays in frame while the world behind it changes

opener_concepts.name: One feature, fully demoed
opener_concepts.premise: the single best action from start to satisfying result
opener_concepts.structure: input -> process -> result; other features only flash at the end
opener_concepts.camera: follows the hand/cursor, cut-ins to detail

opener_concepts.name: Diegetic question -> answer
opener_concepts.premise: the question is written IN the world and the answer is a product action
opener_concepts.structure: question on a board, message or device screen -> product answers by doing
opener_concepts.camera: moves from the question to the place of the answer

opener_concepts.name: Rhythmic collage
opener_concepts.premise: fast fragments on the beat that keep returning to one motif
opener_concepts.structure: 12-20 pieces of 0.3-0.8 s + a motif every 4 beats
opener_concepts.camera: cut on beat, shape match cuts

opener_concepts.name: Logo as stage
opener_concepts.premise: the logo shape grows into a space
opener_concepts.structure: every scene happens inside the logo geometry; ending pulls back to the whole logo
opener_concepts.camera: camera enters openings and curves of the logo

opener_concepts.name: Object relay
opener_concepts.premise: one object travels through the stages of a service until it reaches the recipient
opener_concepts.structure: 4-6 stages (need -> choose -> collect -> pack/process -> arrive), one action each, text only on the object
opener_concepts.camera: every transition is carried by the object; background may change per stage

opener_concepts.name: Brand system showcase
opener_concepts.premise: the brand itself is the product: logo, symbol, mascot, stickers, type and palette as one family
opener_concepts.structure: 8-12 short connected beats; two full color fields mark chapters; loops back to the logo
opener_concepts.camera: each beat is born from the previous one

opener_concepts.name: Claim -> how -> result
opener_concepts.premise: a calm feature announcement: short claim, UI used by a cursor, result blooming from the UI
opener_concepts.structure: claim (1-2.5 s) -> how in UI (2-6 s) -> result (4-6 s), repeated per feature; product UI font throughout
opener_concepts.camera: no cuts; a UI container blooms into a result card, then shrinks into the point where the next claim appears

opener_concepts.name: Living UI ecosystem
opener_concepts.premise: scattered tools tidied by one product icon, the flow used by a persona, results and integrations alive
opener_concepts.structure: 12-16 beats of 2-6 s: scattered tools -> icon born -> UI assembled and used -> result + data -> roles/integrations -> statement + device -> call to action
opener_concepts.camera: transitions carried by UI (panel blooms, badge shrinks, window carousel, icon flip); at most two hard cuts

opener_concepts.name: Flat pop with photos
opener_concepts.premise: people cutouts, flat shapes and brand color fields alternating quickly
opener_concepts.structure: 15-18 beats of 0.3-3 s; nearly every beat changes the background with a visible trigger
opener_concepts.camera: object to lens, push into a field, icon filling the frame, UI action; photo montage on the beat

opener_concepts.name: Through the gradient shapes
opener_concepts.premise: one brand shape repeated in glowing layers; the camera or a light orb passes layer after layer
opener_concepts.structure: 5-8 beats of 2-4 s: dark + light point -> layers bloom/rotate -> guide orb -> tunnel -> portal -> glowing symbol -> logo
opener_concepts.camera: no cuts; each beat is entered through the opening of the previous shape

opener_concepts.name: Product tour with claims
opener_concepts.premise: real UI used like a tour, pausing every few seconds on a short claim over a brand color field
opener_concepts.structure: 9-11 beats of 2-5 s: title with object in the word gap -> UI tour -> lifted card -> claim -> tour -> split UI/claim -> card diagram -> analytics -> wordmark
opener_concepts.camera: carried by UI (dim, lifted card, split screen); 1-2 cuts

canonical_components: text that zooms up then exits left
an input box or search bar being typed into
logo + CTA stacked in the centre as the last scene

background_motion.name: Textured surface + breathing camera + one subtle drift (tint, light or grain)
Large gradient that moves/rotates slowly (2-3 palette colors, 8-15 s)
Floating color blobs (2-4 blurred circles, +/-60 px over 4-6 s)
Living grain/paper texture offset from t (never fresh random noise)
Large geometric/logo shapes rotating 20-40 s per turn, two parallax layers
Particles rising slowly (dust, bubbles, sparks); opacity <= .35 behind text
Grid/pattern breathing in scale or opacity 1.0-1.04 over 6-10 s, no scroll
Giant ghost type drifting slowly behind (low contrast)
Photo/illustration with Ken Burns + two-layer parallax and a dark gradient on the text side
Horizontal flow (streaks, lanes, particle rain) - only when the subject IS speed/flow
Palette color fields alternating (0.15-0.3 s snap/sweep triggered by an object, UI action or beat), always filled with moving shapes

surfaces.name: Horizon glow (dark)
surfaces.recipe: radial accent glow below the frame over a vertical dark gradient

surfaces.name: Diagonal duotone
surfaces.recipe: 160deg linear gradient from darkened accent through base to darkened light accent

surfaces.name: Light mesh (blobs)
surfaces.recipe: pale base + 3-4 large soft radial blobs from the palette drifting +/-60 px

surfaces.name: Spotlight + tint
surfaces.recipe: radial accent tint around the subject fading to base

surfaces.name: Layered sky
surfaces.recipe: vertical pale gradient + 2-3 thin color bands at .2-.4 opacity

surfaces.name: Texture + tint
surfaces.recipe: paper/grain noise multiplied or overlaid at .1-.3 on any of the above

surfaces.name: Grainy gradient
surfaces.recipe: saturated gradients inside shapes and background + one fine monochrome grain layer over everything; grain offset jumps 12x per second from t

render_families.name: Flat solid
render_families.traits: even fills, no shadows, geometric shapes

render_families.name: Flat + color dots
render_families.traits: palette circles of many sizes moving elastically around the object

render_families.name: Soft 3D / clay
render_families.traits: matte pastel, thick rounded corners, soft shadows
render_families.web: Three.js standard material roughness .7-.9, or supplied renders

render_families.name: Glossy 3D
render_families.traits: shiny plastic, rim light, environment reflections
render_families.web: physical material with clearcoat + env map

render_families.name: Isometric
render_families.traits: 30 degree axes, no perspective, tidy blocks
render_families.web: CSS isometric transform or orthographic camera

render_families.name: Metal/marble realistic
render_families.traits: PBR, depth of field, cinematic dark
render_families.web: PBR + HDRI, or supplied render imported as a layer

render_families.name: Neon line on dark
render_families.traits: thin glowing outlines, layered curves and frames

render_families.name: Flat character illustration
render_families.traits: vector characters, warm colors, thin texture

transitions.name: 3D push-through
transitions.how: push in to the leaving text (accelerating), cut, pull back from new text born oversized; layers at different depths

transitions.name: Card/object rotates in
transitions.how: next object arrives from depth with rotateY -35 to 0 under perspective, old one leaves the opposite way

transitions.name: Object with thickness passes the lens
transitions.how: extruded logo, glass card or 3D tile scales 1 -> 2.5 with directional blur and briefly covers the frame

transitions.name: Light sweep
transitions.how: soft light covers 40-60% of the frame at the cut, never 100%

transitions.name: Brand-shape mask reveal
transitions.how: the new scene appears through a growing logo/letter opening (clip-path/mask)

transitions.name: Whip with directional blur
transitions.how: world shifts 120-200 px with ~18 px directional blur in 0.3 s, alternating direction; never reveal the world edge

transitions.name: Rack focus / depth
transitions.how: old scene blurs and recedes, new scene comes sharp from the front

transitions.name: Overlapping choreography, no cut
transitions.how: old elements exit fast while new ones are already entering; camera keeps breathing

transitions.name: Background swap behind a cover
transitions.how: dark/light or color field changes while one of the transitions above covers the frame

openings: In media res: the object is already moving in frame one
Sound first: a hit or effect, the visual follows one beat later
Giant word cropped by the edges; the camera pulls back to reveal the sentence
A drawing line that turns out to be the product/logo shape
A texture close-up that turns out to be part of the product
A question typed diegetically on a world object (not a floating input box)
Problem first: open in the middle of the chaos
Unexpected actor: the real user is visible in the first second
Empty frame, a brand motif rises from the edge layer by layer (prepares a loop ending)
Result first: the product output, very close and blurred, recedes to make room for the claim
Old tools scattered as tilted 3D windows; the product icon is born from behind them
Light point in the dark blooming into rotating gradient layers
Kinetic title assembled from letters arriving from different directions
Object in the gap between the two title words, with a quick snap zoom
endings: Logo born from the last object (morph or closing shape)
Camera pulls back: the world turns out to be the logo
Key word of the last sentence is replaced by the logo
Diegetic CTA: a button in the UI/world is pressed
Seamless loop: the last frame joins the first
Decisive stop: all motion stops together, one sentence, cut
Arrival: the hero object has arrived and the recipient enters frame; brand on the object label only
Callback to the opening: the logo inherits the opening motif and leaves where it entered
Address -> name: the URL is typed, erased from the left, the product name typed in its place
Device on a plinth + icon to lens becoming a color field
Through the portal to the logo
Object lands on a podium built from blocks
Wordmark sharpening from blur on an old brand color field
